title: Domain Model Representation
statement: Determine an appropriate domain model for representing the railway network and its operations.
evidence_excerpt: You should determine an appropriate domain model for representing the railway network and its operations.
clarification_question: What are the specific bounds and persistence expectations for the railway network domain model?

title: Live Train Journey Information
statement: Provide passengers with information about active train journeys including current progress.
evidence_excerpt: An important part of the system is providing passengers with information about active train journeys.

title: Live Information Mechanism
statement: Investigate and design the mechanism used to obtain, calculate, communicate, and update live information.
evidence_excerpt: The mechanism used to obtain, calculate, communicate, and update live information should be investigated and designed by you.
clarification_question: What are the source data feeds and latency requirements for live train information updates?

title: Digital Passenger-Information Displays
statement: Railway stations must contain digital passenger-information displays.
evidence_excerpt: Railway stations should contain digital passenger-information displays.

title: Display Information Prioritization
statement: Investigate what information is most important for digital displays in different locations.
evidence_excerpt: However, you should investigate what information is most important in different locations.
clarification_question: What stakeholder requirements define the specific information needs for each display location type?

title: Display Connectivity and Resiliency
statement: Consider how displays receive updated information and how they behave when connectivity is unreliable.
evidence_excerpt: The solution should consider how these displays receive updated information and how they behave when connectivity is unreliable.
clarification_question: What fallback behavior or cached information must displays show during network outages?
